faqs.question: What is an AI customer service agent for websites?
faqs.answer: An AI customer service agent is a chat assistant trained on your business content. It answers visitor questions in real time, supports multiple languages and can guide users toward enquiry or contact actions.

faqs.question: Can the IGENTX AI agent capture leads automatically?
faqs.answer: The agent captures contact details naturally during chat and saves them to your admin dashboard with a conversation summary. Your team decides which enquiries to pursue and follows up manually, which keeps you in control of CRM accuracy.

faqs.question: Is the AI agent multilingual?
faqs.answer: Yes. The IGENTX AI Customer Service Agent supports multilingual conversations so visitors can get accurate responses in their preferred language. This is valuable for UAE businesses serving diverse local and international audiences.
